column4: BLOCKED ON THE DUMP AND AN IN-GAME CHECK. Each 0x38 mesh header holds a centre vector (+0x24, 3 floats) and a pointer to a bounding-box block (+0x34). Writing either correctly needs their meaning measured on retail models - is the centre the vertex box's middle, what the block holds and in what order - and whether the engine culls by them is an in-game question. The one model here, DummyBCH3DModel, has no block (pointer 0) and a zero centre over a -1..1 cube (measured, scratch MeshBounds probe), so it cannot answer either. Guessing a layout and writing it into every edited mesh could break models that work today. NEXT STEP WITH THE DUMP: measure centre vs vertex box and the block over the 857 FieldData models; if the centre is the box middle and the block an AABB/OBB, recompute both in BchMapModel's geometry writers and have BchModelVerifier check them; OWNER: walk a moved/resized region at grazing angles to see whether geometry outside the old box disappears.
